                                .id(new vn.edu.ute.milktea.entity.recipe.ProductRecipeId(toppingTD.getId(),
                                                nlThachDao.getId()))
                                .product(toppingTD)
                                .material(nlThachDao)
                                .quantity(new BigDecimal("0.050"))
                                .build());

                // 8.7 Topping Trân Châu Trắng (50 g Trân Châu Trắng)
                productRecipeRepository.save(ProductRecipe.builder()
                                .id(new vn.edu.ute.milktea.entity.recipe.ProductRecipeId(toppingTCT.getId(),
                                                nlTCTrang.getId()))
                                .product(toppingTCT)
                                .material(nlTCTrang)
                                .quantity(new BigDecimal("0.050"))
                                .build());

                // 8.8 Topping Kem Cheese (40 g Bột Kem Cheese)
                productRecipeRepository.save(ProductRecipe.builder()
                                .id(new vn.edu.ute.milktea.entity.recipe.ProductRecipeId(toppingKC.getId(),
                                                nlKemCheese.getId()))
                                .product(toppingKC)
                                .material(nlKemCheese)
                                .quantity(new BigDecimal("0.040"))
                                .build());

                // 9. Công thức sơ chế
                // 9.1 Ủ Nước Cốt Trà Đen: 1 kg Trà Đen -> 3000 ml Nước Cốt
                PreparationRecipe prepTra = prepRecipeRepository.save(PreparationRecipe.builder()
                                .name("Ủ Nước Cốt Trà Đen")
                                .outputMaterial(nlCotTra)
                                .standardOutputQuantity(new BigDecimal("3000.000"))
                                .tolerancePercent(new BigDecimal("15.00"))
                                .active(true)
                                .build());

                prepRecipeItemRepository.save(PreparationRecipeItem.builder()
                                .id(new vn.edu.ute.milktea.entity.recipe.PreparationRecipeItemId(prepTra.getId(),
                                                nlTraDen.getId()))
                                .recipe(prepTra)
                                .inputMaterial(nlTraDen)
                                .standardInputQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .build());

                // 9.2 Nấu Trân Châu Đen: 1 kg Trân Châu Thô -> 2500 g Trân Châu Chín
                PreparationRecipe prepTC = prepRecipeRepository.save(PreparationRecipe.builder()
                                .name("Nấu Trân Châu Đen")
                                .outputMaterial(nlTCChin)
                                .standardOutputQuantity(new BigDecimal("2500.000"))
                                .tolerancePercent(new BigDecimal("15.00"))
                                .active(true)
                                .build());

                prepRecipeItemRepository.save(PreparationRecipeItem.builder()
                                .id(new vn.edu.ute.milktea.entity.recipe.PreparationRecipeItemId(prepTC.getId(),
                                                nlTCSong.getId()))
                                .recipe(prepTC)
                                .inputMaterial(nlTCSong)
                                .standardInputQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .build());

                // 10. Mẻ sơ chế mẫu hoàn thành & thiết lập giá vốn bình quân cho nguyên liệu sơ
                // chế
                PreparationBatch batchTra = prepBatchRepository.save(PreparationBatch.builder()
                                .recipe(prepTra)
                                .outputMaterial(nlCotTra)
                                .expectedQuantity(new BigDecimal("3000.000"))
                                .actualQuantity(new BigDecimal("3000.000"))
                                .status(DocumentStatus.DA_GHI_SO)
                                .discrepancyReason("Mẻ ủ cốt trà chuẩn đầu kỳ")
                                .totalCost(new BigDecimal("50000.00"))
                                .unitCost(new BigDecimal("16.666667"))
                                .ratioVariancePercent(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                                .toleranceWarning(false)
                                .createdBy(kitchen)
                                .postedAt(Instant.now())
                                .idempotencyKey(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                                .build());

                prepBatchItemRepository.save(PreparationBatchItem.builder()
                                .id(new PreparationBatchItemId(batchTra.getId(), nlTraDen.getId()))
                                .batch(batchTra)
                                .material(nlTraDen)
                                .recipeQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .actualQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .unitPrice(new BigDecimal("50000.00"))
                                .totalCost(new BigDecimal("50000.00"))
                                .build());

                PreparationBatch batchTC = prepBatchRepository.save(PreparationBatch.builder()
                                .recipe(prepTC)
                                .outputMaterial(nlTCChin)
                                .expectedQuantity(new BigDecimal("2500.000"))
                                .actualQuantity(new BigDecimal("2500.000"))
                                .status(DocumentStatus.DA_GHI_SO)
                                .discrepancyReason("Mẻ nấu trân châu chuẩn đầu kỳ")
                                .totalCost(new BigDecimal("30000.00"))
                                .unitCost(new BigDecimal("12.000000"))
                                .ratioVariancePercent(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                                .toleranceWarning(false)
                                .createdBy(kitchen)
                                .postedAt(Instant.now())
                                .idempotencyKey(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                                .build());

                prepBatchItemRepository.save(PreparationBatchItem.builder()
                                .id(new PreparationBatchItemId(batchTC.getId(), nlTCSong.getId()))
                                .batch(batchTC)
                                .material(nlTCSong)
                                .recipeQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .actualQuantity(new BigDecimal("1.000"))
                                .unitPrice(new BigDecimal("30000.00"))
                                .totalCost(new BigDecimal("30000.00"))
                                .build());

                log.info("Khởi tạo dữ liệu mẫu hoàn tất thành công!");
        }

private InventoryDto.PreparationBatchResponse mapPreparationBatch(PreparationBatch batch) {
        BigDecimal expected = batch.getExpectedQuantity() != null
                ? batch.getExpectedQuantity()
                : BigDecimal.ZERO;
        BigDecimal actual = batch.getActualQuantity() != null
                ? batch.getActualQuantity()
                : BigDecimal.ZERO;
        Account creator = batch.getCreatedBy();
        Material output = batch.getOutputMaterial();
        PreparationRecipe recipe = batch.getRecipe();

        List<InventoryDto.PreparationBatchItemResponse> items = batchItemRepository.findByIdBatchId(batch.getId())
                .stream()
                .map(bi -> InventoryDto.PreparationBatchItemResponse.builder()
                        .materialId(bi.getMaterial().getId())
                        .materialName(bi.getMaterial().getName())
                        .unit(bi.getMaterial().getUnit())
                        .recipeQuantity(bi.getRecipeQuantity())
                        .actualQuantity(bi.getActualQuantity())
                        .unitPrice(bi.getUnitPrice())
                        .totalCost(bi.getTotalCost())
                        .build())
                .toList();

        return InventoryDto.PreparationBatchResponse.builder()
                .id(batch.getId())
                .postedAt(batch.getPostedAt())
                .recipeId(recipe != null ? recipe.getId() : null)
                .recipeName(recipe != null ? recipe.getName() : null)
                .recipeVersion(recipe != null ? (recipe.getVersion() != null ? recipe.getVersion() : 1L) : 1L)
                .outputMaterialId(output != null ? output.getId() : null)
                .outputMaterialName(output != null ? output.getName() : null)
                .expectedQuantity(expected)
                .actualQuantity(actual)
                .differenceQuantity(actual.subtract(expected))
                .unit(output != null ? output.getUnit() : null)
                .discrepancyReason(batch.getDiscrepancyReason())
                .note(batch.getDiscrepancyReason())
                .createdByEmail(creator != null ? creator.getEmail() : null)
                .createdByName(creator != null ? creator.getFullName() : null)
                .status(batch.getStatus() != null ? batch.getStatus().name() : null)
                .totalCost(batch.getTotalCost())
                .unitCost(batch.getUnitCost())
                .ratioVariancePercent(batch.getRatioVariancePercent())
                .toleranceWarning(batch.getToleranceWarning())
                .items(items)
                .build();
    }

InventoryService.mapShiftSettlement.code:
private InventoryDto.ShiftSettlementResponse mapShiftSettlement(ShiftSettlement settlement) {
        Account closer = settlement.getClosedBy();
        List<ShiftSettlementItem> items = shiftSettlementItemRepository.findBySettlementId(settlement.getId());

        List<InventoryDto.ShiftSettlementItemResponse> itemResponses = items.stream().map(it ->
                InventoryDto.ShiftSettlementItemResponse.builder()
                        .id(it.getId())
                        .materialId(it.getMaterial().getId())
                        .materialName(it.getMaterial().getName())
                        .unit(it.getUnit())
                        .bookQuantity(it.getBookQuantity())
                        .actualQuantity(it.getActualQuantity())
                        .discardedQuantity(it.getDiscardedQuantity())
                        .retainedQuantity(it.getRetainedQuantity())
                        .unexplainedDifference(it.getUnexplainedDifference())
                        .unitCost(it.getUnitCost())
                        .lossCost(it.getLossCost())
                        .reason(it.getReason())
                        .build()
        ).toList();

        return InventoryDto.ShiftSettlementResponse.builder()
                .id(settlement.getId())
                .location(settlement.getLocation())
                .closedAt(settlement.getClosedAt())
                .closedByEmail(closer != null ? closer.getEmail() : null)
                .closedByName(closer != null ? closer.getFullName() : null)
                .totalLossCost(settlement.getTotalLossCost())
                .note(settlement.getNotes())
                .items(itemResponses)
                .build();
    }
